t: This is Rainbow Montessori School, a school in Camden. It carries the name Montessori because it follows the educational approach of Maria Montessori, an Italian physician and educator. She was one of the first women to attend medical school in Italy, graduating with honors in 1896, and went on to write about scientific pedagogy. Her method is in use globally in many public and private schools, and this is one of them, here in London.
